summary: ING Nederland. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Large Dutch bank (64,298 staff in 2025) with 19 Amsterdam roles here, all in English but almost all senior.

culture.text: All its openings are in Amsterdam, spread over operations, risk and compliance, and data.
Applications ask for a CV and a motivation letter.
Says it puts 'imperfection' at the heart of its hiring.

open.text: ING Groep N.V., ING Bank N.V. and ING Bank Personeel B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
None of its 19 jobs here require Dutch, though none mention visa support.
Mostly for experienced people: 15 of 19 roles are senior, with 1 entry-level role (a junior business analyst).

growth.text: Grew from 55,901 staff in 2020 to 64,298 in 2025.
Made €23.0 billion revenue and €6.3 billion net profit in 2025.

worth_knowing.text: Negotiations for a new collective labour agreement (cao) started on 5 October.
Churches called on ING to stop financing fossil fuels.
